Genesis 9

Beside elohim: SG singular agreement, PL plural agreement, ? checked, undetermined.

And elohim yvarekh Noah and his sons and said to them, “Have offspring and increase in number, and fill the earth.” “And fear of you and terror of you will be upon every animal of the earth and upon every bird of the sky, upon everything that moves across the ground, and upon all the fish of the sea. They have been given into your hand.” “Every moving creature that is alive will be food for you. Like green plants, I have given everything to you.” “But you must not eat meat with its life, its blood.” “And surely your blood, for your lives, I will demand an accounting for. From the hand of every animal I will demand an accounting for it, and from the hand of a human, from the hand of each man's brother, I will demand an accounting for the life of the human.” Whoever spills a human's blood, by a human his blood will be spilled, because he made humankind in the image of elohim . And you, have offspring and grow numerous; swarm across the earth and grow numerous on it. Then elohim said to Noah and to his sons with him, saying: And I— look, I am establishing my covenant with you and with your descendants after you. and with every living creature that is with you, among the birds, among the livestock, and among all the animals of the earth with you, from all those coming out of the ark to every animal of the earth. And I will establish my covenant with you, and all flesh will never again be wiped out by the waters of the mabul , and there will never again be a mabul to destroy the earth. And elohim said, “This is the sign of the covenant that I am giving between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for generations forever.” I have placed my bow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth. And it will happen when I bring a cloud over the earth and the bow appears in the cloud: And I will remember my covenant that is between me and you and every living creature among all flesh, and the waters will never again become a mabul to destroy all flesh. And the bow will be in the cloud, and I will see it to remember the lasting covenant between elohim and every living creature among all flesh that is on the earth. And elohim said to Noah , “This is the sign of the covenant that I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.” The sons of Noah who came out of the ark were Shem and Ham and Japheth . And Ham was the father of Canaan . These three were the sons of Noah , and from these people spread out across the whole earth. Noah began as a farmer and planted a vineyard. He drank some of the wine and became drunk and uncovered himself inside his tent. And Ham , father of Canaan , saw his father's nakedness and told his two brothers outside. And Shem and Japheth took the garment and placed it on the shoulders of both of them. They walked backward and covered their father's nakedness. Their faces were turned backward, and they did not see their father's nakedness. Then Noah awoke from his wine and learned what his youngest son had done to him. He said, “Cursed is Canaan ! A slave of slaves he will be to his brothers.” And he said, “ barukh is Yahweh elohei Shem ; and may Canaan be a slave to them.” “May elohim make room for Japheth and may he live in the tents of Shem ; and may Canaan be a slave to them.” And Noah lived after the mabul for three hundred years and fifty years. And all the days of Noah were nine hundred years and fifty years; then he died.

# John 21 source attribution

SBL Greek New Testament, edited by Michael W. Holmes; copyright 2010 Society of Biblical Literature and Logos Bible Software. Supplied Faithlife/SBLGNT text and current LICENSE: [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), without warranties. Source: https://github.com/Faithlife/SBLGNT. John 21 extracted, tokenized and NFC normalized; raw token spelling retained. See data/raw/SBLGNT-About.md and SBLGNT-LICENSE.txt for supplied notices.

Tauber, J. K., ed. (2017), *MorphGNT: SBLGNT Edition*, version 6.12, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.376200. https://github.com/morphgnt/sblgnt. Morphological parsing, normalization and lemmatization: [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/). The supplied README links an older SBLGNT EULA for its text; we import surface text independently from Faithlife's supplied current CC BY 4.0 text. John 21 analysis extracted and aligned. The combined master and adapted analysis are distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0, retaining the independent CC BY 4.0 source notices. Derived SQLite contains the same adapted data and carries the same notices. No claim that MorphGNT itself has relicensed its text.

STEPBible.org, Tyndale House Cambridge, Translators Amalgamated Greek New Testament (TAGNT): https://github.com/STEPBible/STEPBible-Data, [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). John 21 lexical identifiers, dictionary glosses, morphology, edition support and structured variant fields extracted. Running English/Spanish, sub-meanings and explanatory notes excluded. Sanitization and alignment are modifications; no source text corrections asserted. Upstream requests referring readers to its repository for current data. Edition codes are edition support, not dated manuscript witnesses.

Exact upstream commits and local evidence files are recorded in data/sources.tsv. Supplied downloads were fetched 2026-10-20; this implementation performed no network access. Local license evidence is checked again by the import script. data/raw/manifest.tsv records SHA-256 hashes of supplied inputs. No endorsement by the source creators is implied.

## Genesis 9 (Hebrew numbering; LXX Psalm 80)
`data/psa81.jsonl` adapts the pinned STEPBible TAHOT by STEPBible.org / Tyndale House Cambridge, CC BY 4.0, commit ed476a8ee6e3f7b3a46fc48af6c7dabc02387b1d. Source and license: https://github.com/STEPBible/STEPBible-Data and `data/raw/TAHOT/TAHOT-Job-Sng.txt` header. Changes: select Genesis 9, split Hebrew marks into fields, remove slash segmentation for display, retain segmentation in surface_raw, strip all English glosses and notes, use explicit Hebrew references. Morphology and transliteration remain TAHOT's. No separate OSHB/WLC source was imported.

`data/resources/PSA.81.jsonl` and the reader reproduce Swete Psalm 80 word forms from Nathan Smith's nathans/lxx-swete / Open Greek and Latin First1KGreek, pinned 26bad3eb42bba98471d154c954e36a6f30a0279d; data CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://github.com/nathans/lxx-swete). Adaptation: group forms by verse and attach Hebrew verse co-occurrence metadata. The derived Greek-form layer is CC BY-SA 4.0; attribution and ShareAlike must accompany redistribution. Hebrew TAHOT fields retain CC BY 4.0. These forms are secondary cross-reference evidence, never the Hebrew render base.

OpenBible.info cross-reference data, CC BY 4.0 (https://www.openbible.info/labs/cross-references/), is filtered by Hebrew lexical overlap and always flagged BORDERLINE. See `data/sources.tsv` and the raw manifest for pins. Resource and detector candidates are project-generated adaptations, not semantic conclusions.

OSHB morphhb Psalms: Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible contributors, [morphhb](https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb), commit 3d15126fb1ef74867fc1434be1942e837932691f. Morphology and segmentation CC BY 4.0 (data/raw/OSHB/LICENSE.md); based on public-domain Westminster Leningrad Codex. Morpheme data is an adaptation aligned to TAHOT; source-specific vocalization is preserved.
